title: Pokémon Horizons Anime Adds 2 New Cast Members
content: The staff of the Pokémon: Horizons anime revealed two new characters and their cast on Friday. The protagonists' voice actresses Minori Suzuki (as Liko) and Yuka Terasaki (as Roy ) perform the new opening theme song "Sekai Tsunagare," produced by HoneyWorks .
author: ANN

title: Mobile Suit Gundam Has Released Five New Series
content: Mobile Suit Gundam has been busy in recent years, with various anime projects taking us back to the original universe that started it all, while others explored brand new galaxies and alternate realities.
author: ComicBook

title: Frieren: Beyond Journey’s End Studio Reveals New Teaser and Release Window for Original Anime Film
content: Frieren: Beyond Journey’s End has emerged as one of the best modern anime, embracing a slow-paced journey and introspective storytelling amid a wave of chaotic series packed with multiple elements. At the same time, its battle sequences have also become some of the highest quality in the medium.
author: ComicBook

title: Rent-a-Girlfriend Gets Season 6
content: The popular Rent-a-Girlfriend ( Kanojo Okarishimasu ) anime will be receiving a sixth season (Season 6), adapting the Cohabitation Arc from the manga series. A celebratory illustration by the anime character designer Kanna Hirayama was also released. You can check it out below.
author: Anime Corner

title: Rent-A-Girlfriend Anime Gets 6th Season
content: The staff for the anime of Reiji Miyajima 's Rent-A-Girlfriend ( Kanojo, Okarishimasu ) manga announced on Saturday that the anime is getting a sixth season. The season will adapt the manga's Cohabitation arc.
author: ANN

title: Cyberpunk Edgerunners 2 Introduces Second Character Called D
content: Studio TRIGGER has introduced the second character, D, for the CYBERPUNK EDGERUNNERS 2 sequel anime . Fans at the Annecy International Animation Film Festival had the chance to see a teaser earlier this week, while Weak Kingsley was previously introduced. An announcement is set for June 29.
author: Anime Corner

title: 'Kanojo, Okarishimasu' Sixth Season Announced
content: The official website of the Kanojo, Okarishimasu ( Rent-a-Girlfriend ) television anime announced a sixth season on Saturday. The character designer, Kanna Hirayama , drew an illustration to commemorate the announcement (pictured above).
author: MyAnimeList

title: 'Shuumatsu no Walküre' Gets Fourth Season
content: Production company Warner Bros. Japan announced a fourth season for the Shuumatsu no Walküre ( Record of Ragnarok ) anime series on Friday, revealing a special announcement promotional video, and a commemorative illustration (pictured) by the manga's illustrator Ajichika .
author: MyAnimeList
